column1: # Curated: the motorcycle fleet of each country. motorcycles_per_1000 = motorcycles and scooters (above 50 cc) in use per 1,000 people, rounded from national registers, the WHO Global status report on road safety's registered two- and three-wheelers and industry associations (ACEM, AISI, VAMM, ABRACICLO, SIAM); Eurostat road_eqs_motorc replaces it in Europe where measured since 2015. mean_age = mean age of the motorcycle fleet in years and annual_km = average distance a motorcycle is ridden in a year, estimated from national registers and travel surveys; small territories and countries without statistics are estimates from their neighbours (their subregion's typical values).
